translations.web: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
translations.bsb: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”
translations.kjv: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
